description: Unit tests for the TLS client handshaker in QUIC, including handshake procedures, ALPN, SNI, 0-RTT, and ECH configurations.

classes.name: TestProofVerifier
classes.description: A mock proof verifier for testing TLS handshake verification, supporting asynchronous verification with pending callbacks.

classes.name: TlsClientHandshakerTest
classes.description: Test fixture for TLS client handshaker, parameterized by QUIC version, setting up client/server connections, and testing handshake behaviors.

methods.name: VerifyProof
methods.description: Verifies proof asynchronously or synchronously, delegating to underlying verifier.

methods.name: VerifyCertChain
methods.description: Handles certificate chain verification, supporting asynchronous operation with pending callbacks.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates the test proof verifier to run asynchronously.

methods.name: NumPendingCallbacks
methods.description: Returns the number of pending certificate verification callbacks.

methods.name: InvokePendingCallback
methods.description: Invokes a specific pending certificate verification callback.

methods.name: CreateSession
methods.description: Creates a new QUIC session for testing.

methods.name: CreateConnection
methods.description: Creates a new client connection for testing.

methods.name: CompleteCryptoHandshake
methods.description: Completes the TLS handshake with default ALPN.

methods.name: CompleteCryptoHandshakeWithServerALPN
methods.description: Completes the TLS handshake with specified ALPN.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns the crypto stream of the current session.

methods.name: InitializeFakeServer
methods.description: Sets up a fake server session for testing.

methods.name: MakeTestEchKeys
methods.description: Generates test ECH keys and config for testing ECH handshake.
